key_phrases.translation: It's our duty to help people who are protected by the law.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Lu mu dégg ci waxtaan wi ngir jëndal ci xam-xam post-colonial?
dialogue.translation: What did you hear during the discussion about post-colonial knowledge?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mu ngi damm dégg doom ci xel ci xale yi, am na xam-xam dëgg ci post-colonial.
dialogue.translation: Because the child fully understood the mind of the young people, he has knowledge that goes beyond post-colonial.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ndax taq moo bëgg waxal ci xel ci post-colonial bi?
dialogue.translation: But why does he still want to write about the post-colonial mind?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sëkk mu bëgg te lu am ci xel ci taam ci xale yi, mu déf ci bëtt ci jën.
dialogue.translation: Only because he wants to see what exists in the minds of the young, he dives deep into the matter.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Lu mu dégg ci bés bi ngir waxal ci xel ci post-colonial?
dialogue.translation: What did he hear today about writing on post-colonial minds?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Xale yi mu ngi def ci bëtt doom, mu ngi waxal ci xam-xam post-colonial.
dialogue.translation: The young people who dive deep, they write about post-colonial knowledge.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ndax bëgg nañu jëndal ci xel ci post-colonial?
dialogue.translation: Why do they want to discuss post-colonial minds?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mu ngi jëndal ci xel ci jën, am na xam-xam dëgg ci post-colonial.
dialogue.translation: Because they discuss the mind of the fish, they have knowledge that goes beyond post-colonial.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Doom yi mu ngi am ci xel ci jën, sëkk mu bëgg jëndal.
dialogue.translation: The children who have knowledge of the fish mind only want to discuss it.
